summary: Intermediate note with no record change this turn, recorded honestly rather than filing a half-measured probe. I started converting the read-index account from source-only to observed with a seventh test function: a leader elected while its append acknowledgement is withheld has no commit in its own term, so a ReadIndex request is accepted and produces no read state (observed: StateLeader, term 2, commit 10, read_states 0) — the queueing half works as the source reading said. The release half did not complete in my two-node probe, and the cause is in the code I had already cited: in ReadOnlySafe mode the release path registers the request and then broadcasts a heartbeat carrying the read context, and a read state appears only once a quorum of heartbeat responses for that context arrives, so dropping the release-time heartbeats (as my probe did) leaves it unsatisfied. The corrected probe needs one more round trip — deliver the release heartbeats to the follower and feed its responses back — before it is worth an execution slot, so nothing is filed and no record is changed; validation confirms no_change with no execution requested.
